facts.text: I am thinking of auditioning for a summer theater camp.

I will perform Puck's "If we shadows have offended" from A Midsummer Night's Dream.
I have always loved the whimsical and mischievous tone of Puck.
I am thinking of incorporating movement into the monologue, such as gestures or subtle dance steps.
I am considering whether to focus more on vocal delivery and let the words speak for themselves.
I will incorporate subtle gestures and movements to bring Puck's playful nature to life.
I will keep the gestures and movements intentional and not overpower the vocal delivery.
I am thinking of adding a slight twirl when I say "If we shadows have offended".

I consider myself a musical theater enthusiast.
